definitions.explanation: Used almost only as ご{清栄|せいえい} in the set opening of formal letters, wishing the reader prosperity and good health. Suitable for both individuals and companies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{清栄|せいえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I wish you all continued prosperity and good health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{貴社|きしゃ}→貴社：15664_kisha⟧⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧ご{清栄|せいえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こととお{慶|よろこ}び⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: We are pleased to know of your company's continued prosperity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{拝啓|はいけい}→拝啓：12790_haikei⟧　⟦{時下|じか}→時下：31853_jika⟧⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧ご{清栄|せいえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こととお{慶|よろこ}び⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: Dear Sir or Madam, I trust this letter finds you in continued prosperity.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧ご{清栄|せいえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こととお{慶|よろこ}び⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧: the standard opening line after ⟦{拝啓|はいけい}→拝啓：12790_haikei⟧
- ご{清栄|せいえい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧: a closing wish for the reader's prosperity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ご{清祥|せいしょう}: health and happiness, for individuals only
- ご{健勝|けんしょう}: good health, for individuals
- ご⟦{隆盛|りゅうせい}→隆盛：14568_ryuusei⟧, ご{盛栄|せいえい}: prosperity, for companies and organizations

WATCH OUT:
Same reading as ⟦{精鋭|せいえい}→精鋭：31509_seiei⟧ (elite, picked troops). ご{清栄|せいえい} is the safe choice when unsure whether the reader is a person or a company.
